title: I, Robot
author: Isaac Asimov
summary: A series of linked stories follows a robot psychologist and the engineers who test machines governed by three simple laws. Each case shows how those laws can go wrong in surprising and logical ways.
readIf: you like puzzle-box science fiction about how artificial minds might think.
skipIf: you want a single flowing novel with deep characters, since the stories are short and idea-driven.

pairings.reason: A modern, funnier look at a created mind that has its own opinions about its rules.
An artificial being seen with great tenderness, for readers who want the human feeling these tales avoid.
Asks what separates people from machines in a bleaker, more unsettling way.
